name: Dark Tie Love-Wing Collar, Halloween Accessory
description:
Some costumes only need one finishing piece to click — and for dark-romance looks, that piece is a collar. This dark tie collar carries a winged-heart accent at the front, the love-wing detail that turns a plain gothic outfit into a character.

It is made as a Halloween and costume accessory: polyester build, one size, light enough to wear through a whole party without it mattering. Unlike jewelry, it reads clearly at party distance, which is exactly the point of a statement collar. Reach for it with vampire and dark-academia looks, lace bodysuits, or any outfit where the neckline feels empty.

The specifics:

  • Material: polyester
  • Type: collar accessory for costumes and Halloween looks
  • Design: dark tie with winged-heart (love-wing) accent
  • Size: one size

Small piece, outsized effect — the kind of accessory that photographs like part of the costume, not an add-on.
short_description: Dark tie collar with a winged-heart love accent. One-size polyester Halloween accessory for gothic and costume looks.
